I couldn't find the travel policy, and I've told Dana that in a reply to her message in #north-team.

I looked through the public shared files and the channels Dana can read: #general, #help-it-ops, #north-team and #north-random. None of them has a travel policy file or a link to one. I didn't check #inc-qfl-sev1 because it's an incident room and unlikely to have it. I didn't use the message search either, since it would also show conversations Dana can't see.

In the reply, I suggested she ask in #general or ask whoever in ops/HR owns the policy. I also offered to pin it in the channel once someone shares it.
